fields.name: sku
fields.label: SKU
fields.description: Unique ID, e.g. CKM-002. Used in shareable links (?stone=CKM-002), so avoid changing it after launch.

fields.name: materials
fields.label: Available materials
fields.description: Add each material with the + button, e.g. Gray granite

fields.name: sizes
fields.label: Available sizes
fields.description: Add each size with the + button, e.g. 24" × 30" × 6"

fields.name: image
fields.label: Image
fields.description: One photo per stone. Upload at about 1600px on the short side.

fields.name: imageAlt
fields.label: Image description (alt text)
fields.description: Short description for screen readers and search engines, e.g. Black granite upright headstone with a curved top.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown on the category tab, e.g. Upright headstones

fields.name: slug
fields.label: URL slug
fields.description: The category page address, e.g. upright-headstones becomes /upright-headstones/. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.

fields.name: order
fields.label: Sort order
fields.description: Tabs are shown from lowest to highest.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro text
fields.description: Two or three sentences shown at the top of the category page (helps search engines).

fields.name: photo
fields.label: Photo (owner, team or showroom)
fields.description: Optional. Without a photo, the story spans the full width.

fields.name: story
fields.label: Story
fields.description: Leave a blank line between paragraphs.

fields.name: serviceIntro
fields.label: Service area text
fields.description: The towns themselves come from Site settings → Service area.

fields.name: answer
fields.label: Answer
fields.description: Two or three plain sentences that make sense on their own. Search engines and AI tools quote these.

fields.name: heroImage
fields.label: Hero photo
fields.description: Wide, calm photo shown behind the headline. At least 2000px wide.

fields.name: nextSteps
fields.label: What happens next
fields.description: Each step in the numbered list beside the form.

fields.name: thankYou
fields.label: Thank-you message
fields.description: Shown after someone sends the form.

fields.name: email
fields.label: Public email address
fields.description: Shown on the site. Lead form submissions are routed separately in the Google Sheet.

fields.name: hours
fields.label: Hours
fields.description: Add each line with the + button, e.g. Mon–Fri 9am–5pm
